verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for an identity-verification service, since some products of this kind are open source. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Plaid Identity Verification's source is published under any license. The pack documents only hosted SaaS features, an llms.txt file and an MCP server, none of which concern source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
